paper.title: video-SALMONN S: Memory-Enhanced Streaming Audio-Visual LLM

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 4 / 4.1 ELViM benchmark; Appendix A
evidence.paraphrase: ELViM (Episodic Learning from Video Memory) simulates an agent that watched a procedural video hours earlier: 1,849 questions over 1,021 target videos in 15 categories, where the target video is embedded at least 30 minutes before the query inside merged 90-minute streams. It tests whether a model can learn procedural knowledge from episodic video memory and retrieve it to support real-time execution; video-SALMONN S reaches 46.7% versus 32.5% for video-SALMONN 2+.

adjudication_notes: Separate benchmark record created because the paper contributes both a memory architecture (video-SALMONN S) and a new memory-centric benchmark (ELViM), per counting_rules.md.
